articles.title: The Court of Owls Come to Roost in ‘The Batman, Part II’
articles.summary: Vertical Entertainment has acquired the rights for the 'Cliffhanger' reboot, showcasing strategic brand synergy. Concurrently, Mr. Freeze is confirmed to appear in 'Stuart Saves the Universe,' expanding its character roster. Filming has also wrapped on the first season of 'Scooby-Doo.' These updates highlight ongoing production and acquisition activities within the entertainment industry, signaling future releases and developments across popular franchises.

articles.title: NIT Jalandhar student who missed Apple internship lands Rs 4.5 lakh monthly Revolut internship
articles.summary: An NIT Jalandhar student demonstrated remarkable resilience by securing a highly sought-after Revolut internship, offering a substantial monthly stipend of Rs 4.5 lakh, even after an initial setback missing an Apple opportunity. This achievement underscores the growing demand for skilled Indian talent in global tech finance and the value of persistent pursuit of professional goals for aspirants.

articles.title: 'Won't reveal my face, will file FIR today': Gurgaon woman biker issues statement after hit-and-run
articles.summary: Pakistan has officially declared Jaish-e-Mohammed (JeM) chief Masood Azhar a fugitive, increasing the bounty on him. This move comes strategically ahead of a crucial Financial Action Task Force (FATF) review, where Pakistan aims to avoid being blacklisted for failing to curb terror financing. The action reflects international pressure on Pakistan to act against designated terrorists.

articles.title: Phoenix turned shipping containers into 40 private transitional homes for homeless seniors; each 160-sq-ft unit has a bathroom, and 56 permanent apartments are planned next
articles.summary: The city of Phoenix, USA, has innovatively addressed senior homelessness by transforming shipping containers into 40 private transitional homes. Each 160-sq-ft unit is designed for a single senior, featuring essential amenities like a private bathroom. This initiative provides dignity and a stable living environment, showcasing a practical urban solution to social welfare challenges.

articles.title: China hits back at Anthropic’s call to restrict its AI, warns against ‘fearmongering, vicious competition'
articles.summary: China has strongly rejected calls from AI firm Anthropic to restrict its artificial intelligence development. Beijing warned against "fearmongering" and "vicious competition," asserting its commitment to innovation. This incident underscores the intensifying global debate over AI governance and the geopolitical struggle for technological leadership, with China advocating for open, fair competition over restrictive policies.

articles.title: More than a summer home: A look inside the Kennedys' historic Hyannis Port estate
articles.summary: Pakistan has reportedly initiated action by listing the terrorist organization Jaish-e-Mohammed (JeM). This significant move likely reflects ongoing international pressure on Pakistan to address terror financing and operational activities within its borders. JeM is a prominent militant group known for its involvement in various regional conflicts and attacks, making this a notable development in global counter-terrorism efforts and regional security dynamics.
